provenance.matrix_contract: POSITION'=C*POSITION; IBM'=IBM*C^-1; sourceRestModel'=C*originalBoneWorld. Original imported pose may differ from bind pose; do not replace rest with inverse(IBM).
provenance.face: Generic source base face with sampled source hand skin tone and authored neutral brown eyes/charcoal lashes. LiHuowang1415608 facial parameters/1400595 makeup are NOT applied.
provenance.hair: Original geometry/UV/weights/IBMs; six uniquely evidenced reconstructed external parent links, not serialized original SMR palettes. RGB data maps suppressed, only source alpha used with neutral black material.
provenance.shader: Source BaseColor/alpha only; no guessed source normal/packed channels, no source anisotropic/SH/FX/cloth/morph shader. Neutral Kiva PBR adaptations.
provenance.weapon: Original four-bone current-pose LBS baked into rigid blade with tassels. Authored hilt center and+Y axis; original skin/IBMs retained in source manifest.
provenance.sheath: Original static source geometry with authored Kiva left-hip placement, following pelvis structural delta.
provenance.ornament: Original Guidao source retained as evidence but not packed: dynamic FX shader is not reconstructed.
provenance.structural_driver_adaptation: Original l22/current imported source anchor proportions; not the YYSLS rest pose. Source ancestor maps to23 existing structural deltas, preserving each palette original source rest model.
